verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-based refund handling ("Add server-side endpoints to handle refunds, voids, delayed captures" - paypal-docs-19) but there's no explicit documentation of full vs. partial refund granularity, nor concrete evidence that the merchant dashboard (vs. Resolution Center for disputes) supports issuing refunds directly. missing for 10: explicit dashboard refund UI documentation, explicit full/partial refund API parameters, and independent confirmation that both channels support partial refunds.
